company_name: Henan Keen Superhard Materials Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides specialized equipment and services essential for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Henan Keen Superhard Materials Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures advanced equipment and provides services for semiconductor fabrication, focusing on precision machining with superhard materials like cubic boron nitride. Their offerings include backgrind, slicing, lapping, polishing, dicing, sawing, scribing, and separation equipment, as well as grinding and polishing services.
